# @solana-programs/quarry-operator

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@solana-programs/quarry-operator.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@solana-programs/quarry-operator)

TypeScript client for the Quarry Operator program, which delegates Quarry rewarder administration

<!-- Generated by `bun run codegen` from programs/quarry-operator/. Edit programs/quarry-operator/README.md instead. -->

## Installation

```bash
bun add @solana-programs/quarry-operator @solana/kit
```

## About

Quarry Operator delegates the administration of a Quarry Mine rewarder (setting rates, creating quarries, allocating shares) to separate roles.

This package was previously part of `@solana-programs/quarry`, which bundled all six Quarry programs.

## Usage

```typescript
import {
  findOperatorPda,
  getDelegateCreateQuarryInstructionAsync,
} from "@solana-programs/quarry-operator";
```
